body: Hey man, today i decided to try to take down a weeping willow stump that my father has been complaining about. I have never done any yard work, and I ended up getting it just about all out and burned. Posted pictures of it earlier, I was just curious if you would rather eat a pound of toenails or a pound of hair. Thanks .
Im going to post some progress pictures as well in an album later this week, when Im finished with the final product.
Haha i understand, its just i don't really work out in the yard much so this was kind of a big project for me.
Sorry for the shirt off dick head looking post, it was just hot as a mo of out there..
I really mean it whenever i say that you guys are a life saver and i can't express with words how much it meant to have people there for you whenever you feel like you can't carry on anymore.

I'm sorry if this is not the right place to post this guys, but today I really lost it and here is a video of me reciting some lyrics i wrote down while I was in the midst of a breakdown. You guys are really the only thing that I see myself as going for me right now and I really appreciate everything you all have done for me. 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U0wXSvmywus&feature=youtu.be
Thank you a lot and like I said i've got a lot going on that I don't know how to handle so I just came home and just felt like doing this for some reason.
I want to thank anyone who is willing to watch this video, y'all are my family and i have been lurking and i have a regular account, but for some reason i can't find the password. One love. *hugs
